description: Form 6252 line 26 instructions, capital assets: 'enter this amount on Schedule D as a short- or long-term gain on the lines identified as from Form 6252.' A capital asset held under a year (price $20,000, basis $10,000, gross profit percentage 50%) with $5,000 received: $2,500 short-term gain on Schedule D line 4, taxed at ordinary rates.
